# Version 4.152.4 (Unreleased)
> **Failed flush cache cleanup**

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.152.4/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.2.1.204/index.md)

## Highlights

The collected 4.152.4 update prevents Ganesh from reusing uninitialized cached textures after failed flushes.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Failed flushes discard unusable cached textures** — Ganesh drops uniquely held thread-safe cache entries after a failed flush, preventing later draws from reusing entries for textures that were never initialized. Entries still held elsewhere are not removed. ([#5287](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5287))
